title: Ewald Coulomb singularity dimension

exx_ewald_dimension.meaning: 3 for periodic three-dimensional Coulomb, 2 for isolated-layer Coulomb; selects which full-Coulomb family is available.

constraints: out_librpa_2d_coulomb_method is available only with exx_ewald_dimension=2; out_librpa_3d_coulomb_method only with 3.
Strict-2D GW: set exx_ewald_dimension = 2 and out_librpa_2d_coulomb_method = ewald; ABACUS must also write librpa_2d_coulomb_head.txt (the 2D Coulomb head/moment artifact).
LibRPA then uses the 2D Ewald Coulomb for Wc and epsilon (use_2d_dielectric = t, use_fullcoul_wc = t); the 2D head/wing is averaged at Wc (rpa_headwing_mode = qavg), not the 3D head/wing path.
PyATB always writes all k-points (full BZ); never pass IBZ k-points or star weights into the head/wing lane.
